No published image shows the errata text; [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB1-109-R2_D2_Artoo_Detoo-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “During battle with C-3PO, may not be targeted by weapons. Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, opponent may not place those cards in Used Pile.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 13). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “During a battle” for “During battle”: “During a battle with C-3PO, may not be targeted by weapons. While aboard a starfighter, it is power, maneuver, and hyperspeed +3.
